title: IIITDWD-ShankarB@Dravidian-CodeMixi-HASOC2021: mBERT based model for identification of offensive content in south Indian languages
reasoning: The paper describes a system for identifying offensive content in Dravidian languages for the HASOC-2021 competition. While it mentions that offensive content often targets people's faith, it does not evaluate or benchmark religion, ethics, or moral reasoning as a core component of the research.
